race.title: CopyBet Follow Us On X Lilies Mares' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A good opportunity for likeable TAKE NO CHANCES to snap a losing sequence stretching back to early-2025. Hollygrove Cha Cha may well get the run of the race, and she just edges Jackie Hobbs for next best. TAKE NO CHANCES (IRE) HOLLYGROVE CHA CHA (IRE) JACKIE HOBBS
race.bettingForecast: Take No Chances (5/4), Hollygrove Cha Cha (2/1), Jackie Hobbs (9/2), St Irene (12/1), La Pinsonniere (14/1)
